author: Totally Not Mark
description:
This is the story of how a small fan group acquired the legitimate Dragon Ball film reels and created the best looking version of the show to date! For the very first time, the original Dragon Ball series is in HD, with the movies pushing all the way up to 4K. This is the true remaster such a legendary series deserves. 

Thanks to Kineko Video for their assistance with this video and all the wonderful work they've produced! 

Written by @AnimeAjay 
Contact @KinekoVideo  - https://x.com/kinekovideo/
title: Fans Embarrass Toei with 4K Dragon Ball
